items.t: Timing chain guides can break
items.job: Replace timing chain, guides and oil pump chain

items.t: Coolant pump connector can short and start a fire (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace electric coolant pump and connector
items.note: Free under recall 24V-608. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Crankcase vent valve heater can short and start a fire (recall)
items.job: Replace crankcase vent (PCV) valve heater
items.note: Free under recall 17V-683. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Passenger seat sensor mat cracks and turns the airbag off
items.job: Replace passenger seat occupancy sensor mat
items.note: Free where recall 17V-605 / 08V-384 applies. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Transfer case and its actuator motor wear out
items.job: Replace transfer case actuator motor
items.note: A worn transfer case itself costs far more; diagnose before buying parts.

items.t: Oil leaks from the oil filter housing and valve cover gaskets
items.job: Replace oil filter housing and valve cover gaskets

items.t: Electric water pump or thermostat fails
items.job: Replace electric water pump and thermostat

items.t: Coolant leaks from the expansion tank, hoses and plastic fittings
items.job: Replace coolant expansion tank and leaking hoses

items.t: Driver airbag inflator may be defective (recall)
items.job: Replace driver airbag module
items.note: Free under recall 23V-797 / 16V-683. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front swivel bearings may not be hardened properly (recall)
items.job: Replace front swivel bearings (steering knuckles)
items.note: Free under recall 19V-678. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear brake hoses may leak (recall)
items.job: Replace rear brake hoses and bleed brakes
items.note: Free under recall 25V-154. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Starter motor can overheat and catch fire (recall)
items.job: Replace the starter motor
items.note: Free under recall 26V-056. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Starter relay can corrode and short out (recall)
items.job: Replace the starter relay and check its wiring
items.note: Free under recall 25V-636. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Steering shaft may be wrongly attached to the column (recall)
items.job: Inspect and secure the steering shaft to the column
items.note: Free under recall 26V-524. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Steering wheel can turn by itself while the car sits still (recall)
items.job: Update the steering control software
items.note: Free under recall 25V-857. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear door locks can release in one movement (recall)
items.job: Replace the rear door lock actuators
items.note: Free under recall 25V-106. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Cargo rail anchors can tear loose in a rear crash (recalls)
items.job: Reattach or replace the cargo rail anchors
items.note: Free under recall 24V-764 or 24V-534. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Transmission control unit can leak oil and lock up a gear (recall)
items.job: Replace the transmission control unit
items.note: Free under recall 23V-821. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Steering gear mounting bolts may be loose (recall)
items.job: Inspect and tighten the steering gear bolts
items.note: Free under recall 23V-770. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Camshaft timing unit bolts can loosen and stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Replace the camshaft timing unit bolts
items.note: Free under recall 23V-707. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Diesel exhaust gas cooler can leak and melt the intake (recalls)
items.job: Replace the exhaust gas cooler and clean the intake
items.note: Free under recall 18V-755 or 21V-907. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Diesel high-pressure fuel pump can fail (recall)
items.job: Replace the high-pressure diesel fuel pump
items.note: Free under recall 21V-586. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Plug-in hybrid battery can short out and catch fire (recalls)
items.job: Replace the high-voltage battery modules
items.note: Free under recall 20V-490 or 20V-601. Check the VIN first.

items.t: High-pressure fuel rail can crack and leak fuel (recall)
items.job: Replace the high-pressure fuel rail
items.note: Free under recall 22V-513. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear brake caliper pistons may be poorly coated (recall)
items.job: Replace the rear brake calipers
items.note: Free under recall 18V-453. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front seat back frame welds can let the seat fold (recall)
items.job: Replace the front seat back frame
items.note: Free under recall 19V-563. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Backup camera view can be blocked or go blank (recalls)
items.job: Update the camera and display software
items.note: Free under recall 19V-684, 20V-598 or 21V-096. Check the VIN.

items.t: Steering tie rod can fracture on the X3 M (recall)
items.job: Replace the steering tie rod
items.note: Free under recall 20V-355. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Left front wheel carrier can crack (recall)
items.job: Replace the front wheel carrier
items.note: Free under recall 24V-909. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Brake vacuum pump can fail and stiffen the pedal (recalls)
items.job: Replace the brake vacuum pump
items.note: Free under recall 13V-454 or 14V-627. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Power steering assist can cut out suddenly (recall)
items.job: Replace or reprogram the power steering control module
items.note: Free under recall 11V-341. Check the VIN first.
